summary: A 4.00 ct Moval-cut centre diamond framed by two triangular pink sapphires in a slim, polished 14K white gold three-stone setting.
description:
An elongated Moval-cut diamond combines the soft curves of an oval with the long silhouette of a marquise. Two triangular pink sapphires add a romantic touch of colour on either side.

Crafted in solid 14K white gold with a three-stone prong setting and a slim polished band. Each pink sapphire weighs approximately 0.30–0.50 ct, bringing the total gemstone weight to approximately 4.60–5.00 ct.

Limited-time promotional price: $5,900 CAD, reduced from $8,429 CAD (30% off). Each ring is made to order, and customization is available on request. Diamond and sapphire origin are confirmed with your order. Carat weights and gemstone proportions may vary slightly.
